meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后，当需要了解代码库时，Claude 会从头到尾完整读取每一个源文件，大文件会分段读完，从而建立对项目的整体理解。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目、面对不熟悉的代码库，或说出“学习代码库”、“读取代码库”等要求时触发。

say.note: Claude 会通读所有源文件。

say.text: 我对这个项目不熟，先通读全部源码再动手。
请完整阅读代码库，然后告诉我项目结构。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude systematically reads every source file in full, paging through large files, to build a deep understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new or unfamiliar project, or when asked to learn, read, prime, or get up to speed on the codebase.

say_en.note: Claude will read all source files.

say_en.text: I'm unfamiliar with this project; read all the source code first.
say_en.note: It will read the code completely.

say_en.text: Read the codebase in full, then tell me the project structure.
